entries.title: Nightly backups, checked every night
entries.summary: Menu data and Eat Hub accounts are now backed up every night to two separate providers in the EU. Each night's backup is test-restored before older copies are pruned, so we know it works, not just…
entries.html: Menu data and Eat Hub accounts are now backed up every night to two separate providers in the EU. Each night's backup is test-restored before older copies are pruned, so we know it works, not just that it ran.

entries.title: Published menus are served from the edge
entries.summary: Your embedded menu is now served from a published copy held close to your visitors. It loads fast, and it keeps working even if our database is having a bad day.
entries.html: Your embedded menu is now served from a published copy held close to your visitors. It loads fast, and it keeps working even if our database is having a bad day.

entries.title: The embedded menu stays put
entries.summary: Opening a dish's allergen details on a filtered menu no longer jumps the page back to the top.
entries.html: Opening a dish's allergen details on a filtered menu no longer jumps the page back to the top.

entries.title: See your menu working before you sign up
entries.summary: When we send you a demo link, it now opens your own menu live as an Edible menu, with plans a tap away. "Get started" drops that menu straight into your editor, with your business name and region…
entries.html: When we send you a demo link, it now opens your own menu live as an Edible menu, with plans a tap away. "Get started" drops that menu straight into your editor, with your business name and region already filled in.

entries.title: Faster uploads, and multi-page PDFs work
entries.summary: Submitting menu photos comes back in a fraction of the time it used to, especially when you send several at once.
entries.html:
Submitting menu photos comes back in a fraction of the time it used to, especially when you send several at once.

Multi-page PDF menus, which could previously fail part-way, are now read page by page and merged into one menu. A section that runs across a page break stays one section.

entries.title: Location and device data is stripped from your menu photos
entries.summary: Phones tuck location and device details into every photo. When you upload a menu photo, we strip those before it's stored. The photo is kept for reading the menu, nothing more.
entries.html: Phones tuck location and device details into every photo. When you upload a menu photo, we strip those before it's stored. The photo is kept for reading the menu, nothing more.

entries.title: Clearer allergen badges
entries.summary: One badge per allergen family, never two for the same category on the same dish.
entries.html:
One badge per allergen family, never two for the same category on the same dish.

Matching got stricter in the right direction too: if your profile says "gluten", dishes marked wheat, rye, barley or oats are caught as well, so nothing slips through on a technicality.

entries.title: PDF menus, and plain words when a scan fails
entries.summary: You can now upload PDFs as well as photos: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 5MB each.
entries.html:
You can now upload PDFs as well as photos: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 5MB each.

When a menu can't be read, you get a plain explanation: the menu was unreadable, we're busy, the daily limit was reached, you're offline, or it timed out. No more technical errors or endless spinners, and a direct link to support if you need it.

entries.title: Plans and pricing are live
entries.summary: Edible now has plans: a free tier to get going, and a Pro plan for venues that want their menu in their own branding. You can upgrade from inside the builder.
entries.html: Edible now has plans: a free tier to get going, and a Pro plan for venues that want their menu in their own branding. You can upgrade from inside the builder.

entries.title: Your menu in your colours and fonts
entries.summary: Menus can now carry your own branding. Pick your colours and fonts in the builder and the menu follows, including the version embedded on your website.
entries.html: Menus can now carry your own branding. Pick your colours and fonts in the builder and the menu follows, including the version embedded on your website.

entries.title: Your allergen matrix, built from your menu
entries.summary: As you build a menu, Edible now shows the dietary spreadsheet (the allergen matrix venues are asked to keep), generated from what you've entered. There's no separate document to keep in step with the…
entries.html: As you build a menu, Edible now shows the dietary spreadsheet (the allergen matrix venues are asked to keep), generated from what you've entered. There's no separate document to keep in step with the menu: change a dish, and the matrix follows.

entries.title: Try Edible with a photo of your menu
entries.summary: You can now try Edible before creating an account. Photograph your menu and we turn it into a live, filterable menu you can explore straight away. It is the same thing your diners would see.
entries.html: You can now try Edible before creating an account. Photograph your menu and we turn it into a live, filterable menu you can explore straight away. It is the same thing your diners would see.

entries.title: Signing up is simpler
entries.summary: Creating a Menu Builder account is now a shorter, clearer flow, with fewer steps between you and your first published menu.
entries.html: Creating a Menu Builder account is now a shorter, clearer flow, with fewer steps between you and your first published menu.

entries.title: The menu page got a rebuild
entries.summary: The page diners see when they open an Edible menu was rebuilt and polished: a cleaner layout, easier reading on a phone, and a tidier embed when the menu sits inside your own website.
entries.html: The page diners see when they open an Edible menu was rebuilt and polished: a cleaner layout, easier reading on a phone, and a tidier embed when the menu sits inside your own website.
